# Buggregator

> Free, open-source debugging server: exceptions, dumps, emails, profiling and logs from your app in one real-time UI. One docker run, nothing to install in your app.

## Docs
- [Documentation index for LLMs](https://docs.buggregator.dev/llms.txt): every docs page with a short description
- [Getting started](https://docs.buggregator.dev/getting-started.md)

## Features
- [Sentry-compatible exceptions](https://buggregator.dev/features/sentry)
- [Email testing (SMTP)](https://buggregator.dev/features/email-testing)
- [Profiler (XHProf)](https://buggregator.dev/features/profiler)
- [HTTP proxy](https://buggregator.dev/features/http-proxy)
- [SMS testing](https://buggregator.dev/features/sms)
- [Mock server](https://buggregator.dev/features/mock-server)
- [Xdebug proxy](https://buggregator.dev/features/xdebug)
- [Logs (Monolog)](https://buggregator.dev/features/logs)
- [HTTP dumps](https://buggregator.dev/features/http-dumps)
